coin.vsBtc: XLM and BTC turn months apart (XLM topped in May 2021 and Dec 2024, BTC in Nov 2021 and Oct 2025; XLM bottomed in Dec 2022, a month after BTC).
coin.behave: XLM's bulls and bears are dated from XLM's own tops and bottoms (its 2021 top in May, its bear low on 31 Dec 2022 and its last top in Dec 2024). Binance XLMUSDT starts in May 2018, after XLM's Jan 2018 top, so the first period (Jul 2018 – Mar 2020) is a drop from the data start and only the 2021–22 bear is compared.
coin.dates: high 25 Jul 2018 (data starts May 2018), low 12 Mar 2020, top 11 May 2021, bottom 31 Dec 2022, top 1 Dec 2024
coin.hist: XLM history starts 31 May 2018 (Binance XLMUSDT); the 100W exists from Apr 2020 and the 200W from Mar 2022, so the weekly read starts in Apr 2020.
